digest.component_or_area: OpenAI provider integration and LLM model routing
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107.2 supports OpenAIResponsesModel construction for openai: and openai-responses: prefixes, but rebar lacks four production-side unblocks (KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES, is_resolvable derivation, _PROFILE_RESOLVERS, openai→openai-chat normalizers) that prevent runtime routing to Responses-ready paths.

Custom base_url OpenAI-compatible endpoints (LMStudio/Ollama/vLLM/LiteLLM) and per-candidate endpoint overrides are Chat-Completions-only in rebar because _build_openai is keyed only on 'openai' and 'openai-chat' prefixes, not 'openai-responses'.

Third-party OpenAI-compatible providers (deepseek, cerebras, moonshotai, heroku, gateway/openai) construct ChatModel classes under pydantic-ai 1.107.2 and have no Responses construction path in the current pin.

Contract tests in test_openai_responses_contract.py parameterize identical assertions (structured output, streaming, tool calls, 429 retry, custom-base-URL routing) over openai-chat: and openai-responses: prefixes to measure migration safety and behavioural parity.

xai: and groq: prefixes raise ImportError (missing optional extras) and cannot be tested for Responses readiness in this worktree; vendor-side /v1/responses support for any third-party endpoint remains unresearched.
